title: Final Answer for Air
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature for air must be correctly calculated as T_B = 5.8 x 10^2 K.

title: Final Answer for Helium
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature for helium must be correctly calculated as T_B = 7.5 x 10^2 K.

title: Use of Adiabatic Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the adiabatic process formula T_B = (p_B/p_A)^{(γ-1)/γ} T_A.

title: Correct Value of Gamma for Air
description: Important Criteria: The value of gamma for air must be correctly identified as 1.4.

title: Correct Value of Gamma for Helium
description: Important Criteria: The value of gamma for helium must be correctly identified as 5/3.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the calculations of pressures and temperatures.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid arithmetic mistakes in the final calculations of temperatures.
